concepts.today: this day, this moment, being here now
concepts.ending: death, goodbye, the empty space left
concepts.alive: the will to live, breath, choosing to stay
concepts.merge: where one body ends and another begins; us
concepts.becoming: who I am and who I could be; versions of a self
concepts.seen: being watched, witnessed, looked at, hiding
concepts.shame: shame, wrongness, what was not spoken
concepts.made: what people make and break; the built world
concepts.old: deep time; what was here before us and will outlast us
concepts.home: home, a place left, a place to return to
concepts.free: freedom, getting out, walls that bend
concepts.names: words, names, definitions; the nouns we made up

notes.a-conversation-among-birds: a field note more than a poem; the scythe carries it
notes.blood-oh-once-you-called: the poem is pain outgrown; "growing" fits it better than "change", and some vocabularies cannot say which
notes.burned-invitingly: about harm; its doors go to life and death and the snare, never to anything light
notes.dear-bottle: a small comic poem carrying a large idea, letting go; the scale is the joke
notes.hey-you-there-hey-you-here: so short that every idea it touches is the same one, the edge between two people; the second and third doors are that edge seen from other sides
notes.late-why-so-late: an airport, a flirt, a fear; light where the ideas are heavy, which is the point and the strain
notes.not-in-my-life: a refusal; "home" here is the life he keeps, not a place
notes.oh-the-horror-i-say: a joke poem; any large idea sits on it heavily, and "the word and the thing" is the only honest one
notes.out-to-play-he-calls-them: a fishing song; the ideas reach it only through the call and the debt
notes.sit-let-us-listen: a still list of what is in front of him; under tensions the moment has no other side, so the flowers carry the second door
notes.today-i-write-about-red: a poem about a colour; every idea it opens is borrowed from the colour's family
notes.i-came-out: a second version of The Mist; its doors are chosen apart from that poem's so the two lead different ways
